description: This Java source file defines the AdminClient class, which communicates with a running OFBiz server instance via network socket commands to request server status or shutdown.

classes.name: AdminClient
classes.description: A utility class for sending commands to an OFBiz server to check status or initiate shutdown.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the current status of the OFBiz server.

methods.name: requestShutdown
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the server to shut down.

methods.name: sendSocketCommand
methods.description: Handles the socket communication, sending a command and reading the response.
